'''2011 Worlds Day 3 Brian Herold DS Imperial Occupation''' was the Dark Side constructed list played by [[Brian Herold]] at [[2011 World Championship]] (Day 3).

Informal illustrated sheet; dest [[Brian Herold]].

== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' [[Imperial Occupation]]
* '''Format:''' [[Legacy Open]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 3
